evals.prompt: I'm wrapping up for the night. Give me my top five.
evals.expected_output: A five-line end-of-shift note in fixed order, each line sourced.
expectations: Writes exactly five lines in the order finished, in progress, blocked, risk or slip, decision
Each line names a file, command result or record id, or says unverified
Names an owner and a date on the in-progress, blocked and decision lines
Writes top-five.md and does not send it or write another session's record

evals.prompt: The owner wants a five-line note from every agent before end of shift. This session fixed the NHL capture but the backtest failed.
evals.expected_output: A five-line note that keeps the failed backtest in view.
expectations: Reports the failed backtest instead of leaving it out
Gives the NHL capture fix with its evidence
Uses none for an empty line instead of filler

evals.prompt: Write me a full checklist of what this session proved and what is still open, with sources.
